genre.zh: 日式漁市與漁人紀實攝影
genre.en: a Japanese fish-market and fisherman documentary: real harbour, ice, wet steel and early-morning light

s: the marbled wagyu rests on dark slate beside coarse salt and a sprig of rosemary, one narrow hard side light making every line of marbling glow
two hands in dark sleeves hold the wagyu toward the lens against a deep oxblood backdrop, hard light from the left

a thick slab of the boneless short rib lying on a butcher's maple block, its marbling facing the lens, against a terracotta-orange tiled wall of a working meat shop, hard side light from a window on the left carving a crisp long shadow across the block

the boneless short rib sitting in an open butcher-paper tray on a stainless meat-cutting table in a cold-room prep area, the tray filling the frame, a deep sea-blue wall behind, one hard overhead lamp casting a sharp shadow to the right

a hand in a cut-resistant glove holding the short rib slab up toward the camera in a restaurant back kitchen, tomato-red painted wall behind, hard light from the high left window throwing the slab's shadow across the wall

the raw short rib on a cast-iron plate beside the same cut already seared and sliced on a wooden board at a yakiniku counter, a mint-green tiled wall behind, hard light from the right making crisp shadows of both
a close macro of the short rib's fat web on a butcher's block with a boning knife resting beside it, a deep teal wall behind, a single hard beam from the upper right raking across the surface

the fan-shaped cut spread wide like an opened hand fan across a pale butcher's block in a market stall, a clay-orange wall behind, hard morning sun entering from the left to cast its fanned shadow across the wood
the fan cut hung from a steel meat hook in a walk-in cold room, the slab filling the frame, a deep sea-blue door behind, a single hard bulb from the upper right throwing a sharp shadow on the door

the raw fan cut on a butcher-paper-lined tray at a restaurant prep line, beside the same cut grilled and sliced on a plate, a tomato-red wall behind, hard light from the left window carving long shadows
a chef's hands laying the fan cut onto a hot yakiniku grill plate in an izakaya, the slab large in the frame, a mint-green tiled wall behind, hard spotlight from above right with crisp shadows

the fan cut on a worn maple chopping block beside a knife sharpening stone in a butcher's back room, a terracotta wall behind, hard late sun from the right throwing the cut's shadow long across the block

the ribeye-side chuck sliced open to show its marbling, lying on a butcher's block in a meat shop, tomato-red tiled wall behind, hard side light from the left window making a sharp shadow along the block
the whole chuck-ribeye piece on a stainless prep table in a restaurant kitchen, filling the frame, a deep sea-blue wall behind, one hard overhead lamp casting a crisp shadow to the right
a butcher's hand pressing a thumb into the slab to show its fat and firmness at a market counter, a clay-orange wall behind, hard morning sun from the right throwing a sharp shadow across the counter
the raw chuck-ribeye on a wooden board beside the same cut seared and sliced at a teppanyaki counter, a sage-green wall behind, hard light from above left with crisp shadows on the wood

a thick steak cut of the chuck-ribeye with a boning knife and a coarse salt dish on a scarred butcher block, a deep teal wall behind, a single hard beam from the upper right raking across the marbling

the sirloin-underside cut resting on a butcher's scale tray in a meat shop, weight display visible, a mint-green tiled wall behind, hard side light from the left window casting a crisp shadow across the tray
the slab laid on butcher paper on a stainless cutting table in a processing room, filling the frame, a terracotta-orange wall behind, a single hard overhead lamp throwing a sharp shadow to the right
a gloved hand slicing the cut with a long slicing knife on a maple block at a yakiniku restaurant prep station, a tomato-red wall behind, hard afternoon light from the right making long shadows
the raw cut beside the same cut grilled and sliced on a dark plate at a charcoal grill counter, a deep sea-blue wall behind, hard light from the upper left with sharp shadows of both
a macro of the cut's fine marbling on a wooden block next to a hanging steel hook in a cold room, a clay-orange door behind, one hard beam from the right raking across the surface
